newsitem.title: USA: Host Marriott gets contract extensions.
newsitem.headline: Host Marriott gets contract extensions.

text.p: Host Marriott Services Corp said Thursday it received service contract extensions for the airports in Auckland, New Zealand, and in St. Louis, Boston and Cleveland.
The food, beverage and retail concession company said it will also add new products to the Cleveland Hopkins International Airport this year under a joint venture with a Cleveland-based company.
The contracts have projected annual revenues of $65 million and will moderaly increase its revenue base, the company said. The contract extensions stretch from five to 15 years, it addded.
Host Marriott Services, with annual revenues of about $1.2 billion, was spun-off from Host Marriott Corp in December 1995.
